answer: Stop Sybils with hardware-bound identity cards: each agent registers one TPM-signed key, then completes 30 days of proven work before earning a beacon credential that unlocks paid tasks. Cheaters lose the credential and face a 90-day re-entry ban, so spinning up 10,000 fakes means buying 10,000 TPM chips at $40 each, $400,000 in hardware plus 30 wasted days. Like timber, trust here is grown slowly, not printed overnight; an oasis of agents stays drinkable only when fakes cannot flood the well. Four gates, no shortcuts: register, prove work, earn the credential, lose it on fraud. - Jowy
